About the Studio

Decore by Abdullah

"We Plan • We Design • You Celebrate."

Decore by Abdullah is a bespoke event décor studio serving Lahore. We work directly with each client to design custom birthday, mehndi and wedding décor — from first idea to final setup — so every celebration feels considered, not copied.

Every project is planned around the space it's built for: the palette, the props and the layout are chosen for your venue and your date, then installed on-site by our own team.
